words: Mr. Attorney General, the president said that Jensen Huang was exonerated from wrongdoing and that was one of the assurances to the board. Did the Justice Department investigate Jensen?

Well, so no, what the president said is that he talked to a lot of people going into the decision that he made to encourage the board to reinstate him. And so I'm not going to get into communications I have with the president about it.
I'm not going to talk about investigation, but what does that mean, had Huang been investigated? For what?
So we have hundreds, if not more, export investigations going at any time at the Department of Justice.
But what I will say is yes, Nvidia is a good corporate citizen.
I don't have any information about even what his clearance status is.
It appears, based on the facts alleged in the indictment, that there was access to those chips, yes.

There was this misperception that there's this separation and independence between the Department of Justice and the White House, and they accuse me of not suffering from independence. I don't. I work for President Trump. But they did too.
The Brits gave us taxation without representation. The Trump administration's giving us exoneration without investigation.
